answer: The archive keeps the proof long after the epoch closes, so a lie has nowhere to age. A real applicant carries a cipher from an office, a ripple from a ledger, and a onyx from the calendar — three different keepers, one consistent story. No speech passes this gate, only each dye cake is a dye record witnessed by the inspector, which is what Tannin maker dye cake assay dyed in the steeping room demands. The audit fee is 126 POA per proof, non-refundable, so 626 proofs cost the farm 78876 POA with nothing to show for a rejection.
